name: Plugin Entry
description: TPM plugin entry point and main command wrapper. plugin.tmux bootstraps the plugin, validates dependencies, and sets up the environment. rendez-vous is the user-facing popup launcher.

name: Core Scripts
description: Executable bash scripts that implement session management, persistence, window linking, notifications, and the interactive picker. These are the functional core of the plugin.

name: Configuration
description: Project configuration files for linting, type-checking, commit conventions, and pre-commit hooks.

name: Documentation
description: Project documentation including README, contribution guidelines, code of conduct, changelog, and agent guidelines.

name: Analysis Output
description: Understand-Anything analysis artifacts — knowledge graph, fingerprints, metadata, and configuration.

name: Tooling & Templates
description: Build tooling templates and miscellaneous files used for changelog generation and configuration.
